name: @kie-ai-tool/mcp

tools.name: approve_media_generation
tools.description: Chat approval mode only (KIE_AI_APPROVAL=chat): record the person's yes to a prepared plan after showing them every item and its price. Never call it without their explicit yes to this exact plan. Credit caps still apply. In form mode the app's approval form does this instead.

planId.description: The planId from prepare_media_generation that the person said yes to

acceptUnknownPrice.description: Set only when the plan has an item with an unknown price and the person was told so before saying yes

tools.name: finalize_upload
tools.description: Finalize staged widget media server-side and upload it to Kie.ai. App-only helper; public capabilities never enter model content.

media_id.description: Opaque media ID returned after browser upload

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the kie.ai credits left on this API key. Free. 1 credit is about US$0.005.

tools.name: get_model_schema
tools.description: Read a kie.ai model's input fields from its live schema: names, types, which are required, allowed values and defaults, plus a minimal request example for run_model. Free; cached for 24 hours.

model.description: Exact kie.ai model id from search_models, e.g. "gpt-image-2-text-to-image" or "bytedance/seedance-1.5-pro"

raw.description: Return the full dereferenced request schema instead of the compact field list (more tokens)

tools.name: get_model_status
tools.description: Check a kie.ai model before using it: kie.ai's current price text and its success rate over the last hour and 24 hours. Free. A low or abnormal success rate means tasks are failing right now; pick another model or wait.

model.description: Exact kie.ai model id from search_models, e.g. "gpt-image-2-text-to-image" or "bytedance/seedance-1.5-pro"

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Get the status of a generation task with intelligent polling guidance. Returns task status, results, and recommended polling strategy (interval, timing, next steps) based on task type (image/video/audio).

task_id.description: Task ID to check status for

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Create short-lived capability URLs for a browser or HTTP client to upload media to this MCP server. Available only when Streamable HTTP storage is explicitly configured.

filename.description: Original filename shown in download metadata

content_type.description: Declared media MIME type; bytes are checked after upload

size.description: Exact upload size in bytes, maximum 25 MiB

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List source-backed catalog models. Filter by words from capabilities, model names, or descriptions.

filter.description: Optional text or capability filter, for example: lip sync

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List recent tasks with their status

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return

tools.name: prepare_media_generation
tools.description: Prepare one to six validated media generations, resolve safe defaults and pricing, persist a caller-context-bound plan, then request host approval when the transport supports it without calling a provider.

tool.description: Registered generation tool name, or "run_model" with args {model, input} for any kie.ai catalog model

items.description: One to six independent generation requests

defaultProfile.description: Optional explicit safe default policy. The current catalog policy is safe.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent task creates for this plan (1-4, default 4)

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search kie.ai's live catalog of 200+ image, video, audio and chat models by words, task type or provider. Free. Returns each model's exact id, task types and kie.ai's price text. Use the id with get_model_schema and run_model.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the model id, title, provider or task type, e.g. "veo" or "image edit"

taskType.description: kie.ai task type, e.g. "Text to Image", "Image to Video", "Text to Speech", "Lip Sync"

tools.name: submit_media_generation
tools.description: Submit a single unexpired, unchanged plan approved in this caller context exactly once. The persisted approval state is the authorization boundary; the plan hash detects accidental mutation only. The stored plan controls a maximum of four concurrent task creates.

planId.description: Approved plan ID to submit exactly once

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload validated media directly to Kie.ai from Base64 or a CLI-approved local file path. Arbitrary URL imports are intentionally unsupported to avoid delegated SSRF.

file_base64.description: Base64 media bytes or a data URL (maximum 10 MiB decoded)

file_path.description: CLI-only local media path. Requires KIE_CLI_UPLOAD_ROOTS and is unavailable to MCP adapters

content_type.description: MIME type for raw Base64; data URLs provide it inline

tools.name: upload_widget
tools.description: Open a secure file picker for uploading local media. MCP Apps hosts render the inline widget; other clients receive instructions for upload_file.

tools.name: wait_for_task
tools.description: Wait for a generation task to complete in a single call, so you don't have to poll get_task_status repeatedly. Pass the task_id returned by any generation tool: it blocks until the result is ready (or the timeout) and returns the final URLs, streaming progress meanwhile. By default it polls the Kie API directly (no setup); if a callback rendezvous is configured (KIE_AI_RESULT_URL, rendezvous_url, or a KIE_AI_CALLBACK_URL ending in /kie/callback) it waits on that instead. Tip for long jobs: clients should enable resetTimeoutOnProgress with a generous maxTotalTimeout.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by a generation tool to wait for

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait before giving up

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between status checks while waiting

rendezvous_url.description: Optional callback rendezvous result base URL (e.g. https://felo-workers.felo.workers.dev/kie/result). Omit to poll the Kie API directly (the default). When set, or when KIE_AI_RESULT_URL / a KIE_AI_CALLBACK_URL ending in /kie/callback is configured, it waits on the rendezvous instead
